title: Vault: leadership failover test (step-down, raft re-election)
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster vault --yes` (+ `--json`). A controlled step-down on the active node promotes a standby; RTO is about 2.0s (e.g. vault-2 to vault-1). Recovery is skipped because Raft leadership is location-independent and the cluster served reads/writes throughout.

observe.what: vault-step-down on the active triggers a standby promotion; original primary -> new primary (e.g. vault-2 -> vault-1); RTO ~2.0s; recovery = skipped (Raft leadership location-independent)
JSON failover result: originalPrimary + newPrimary differ, rtoSeconds ~2.0, recovery skipped; cluster served throughout

whatProves: VaultAdapter.FailoverTestAsync issues a raft step-down on the active node, observes a standby being promoted with RTO ~2.0s, and reports recovery as skipped because Raft leadership is location-independent and the cluster never lost availability.
